# Gate 1 package - BI-PF-1268
**Eventing SSOT (Go): event core - append-only store, emit, monotonic seq, cursor/since**

## Plain language
**What/why:** The canonical stream has no reliable cursor (since = string timestamp compare) and no Go-native core; new
shipped logic must be Go. -> A Go event core owning emit + append-only store + monotonic seq + cursor reads; single writer.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1268
  prior_decisions : ['ADR-0005: Go core owns store+emit+seq+cursor; Python thin client; single writer; A1 seam; extend go/pfcore first (Q1)', 'BI-PF-1267: event-envelope contract (schema) defined; wire-request op enum = ping/describe/validate/canonicalize', 'core/events.py:1-11 is the single writer of events.jsonl (Python) until the 1272 cutover (Q4)', 'core/go_host.py: stateless one-shot subprocess seam (stdin/stdout), fail-closed, builds the binary on demand', 'ADR-0001: new shipped/sensitive logic -> Go under go/; no new Python modules in core/']
  existing_path   : ['Go host + op dispatch -> go/pfcore/pfcore.go Handle; main.go reads one wire-request', 'wire contract + op enum -> core/contracts.py (_WIRE_REQUEST) + go/contract + go/pfcore mirrors', 'event store (SSOT) -> products/<project>/events.jsonl via core/events.py + core/log_router', 'retry sink -> core/dead_letter_queue.py', 'portable exclusive lock pattern -> core/worker.py:84-105 (O_CREAT|O_EXCL lockfile)', 'invocation -> core/go_host.invoke(op, contract_name, payload, req_id, source)']
  assumptions     : ['C1 event ops are added to go/pfcore (not a separate binary) by extending the wire-request op enum (additive)', 'C2 the stateless Go core receives the store path in the payload (it does not know ROOT)', 'C3 during 1268 Python REMAINS the writer (no dual write); Go ops are exercised by tests + available via go_host; the emit-path cutover is 1272', 'C4 portable exclusive lock (O_CREATE|O_EXCL lockfile, mirroring core/worker) for append+seq; stdlib-only Go (no new deps)', 'C5 monotonic seq = last persisted seq + 1 under the lock (sidecar counter only if needed)']
  divergences     : ['extending the frozen wire-request op enum is a contract change -> recorded as a decision (additive; both Go mirrors + parity test)', 'a Go writer alongside the Python writer would break single-writer -> explicitly avoided until the 1272 cutover']
  open_questions  : ["Q1 op shape: discrete ops (event_append/event_read) vs one 'events' op with an action field", 'Q2 wiring for 1268: ops exercised by tests + reachable via go_host (dormant on the emit path) vs feature-flagged call', 'Q3 seq source: last-line+1 vs a sidecar counter file', 'Q4 store scope/path passed by the caller (product_forge root vs product dir)', 'Q5 ownership: 1268 builds+exposes the core; the Python cutover stays 1272 (no overlap)']
IMPACT REVIEW
  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation
  Add event ops to go/pfcore | aligned | ADR-0005; go/pfcore/pfcore.go Handle; B1 pilot (BI-PF-0394) | None
  Extend wire-request op enum (additive) | aligned | core/contracts.py _WIRE_REQUEST; go/contract + pfcore mirrors; parity test | None
  Python remains the writer (no dual write) | aligned | core/events.py:1-11; ADR-0005 Q4 | None
  Stateless core takes store path in payload | aligned | go/pfcore/main.go:16-40 | None
  New Python module in core/ | violates | config/language-rule.json | edit core/go_host.py only
  Stdlib-only Go (no new deps) | aligned | go/pfcore/go.mod | None

## Gate 1.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 1.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=mimo-v2.6-flash sha=1bfb2402407f)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 7 (BLOCKER 0 / MAJOR 0 / MINOR 5 / NIT 2); dispositions: actioned 5, pending 2; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | MINOR | New failure_matrix row EVENT_OUTBOX_BOUND_EXCEEDED mandates "enable backpressure", but config_contract defines only EVENT_INLINE_PAYLOAD_LIMIT/EVENT_OUTBOX_ENABLED; no backpressure knob or owner is specified, so the control is unimplementable as written. | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1268 design/spec; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1268.md. |
| 2 | MINOR | FR-1/FR-2 `requirements[].verification` still point solely to eventstore_pg_test.go while new controls (outbox prune, payload GC) are owned by 1268; requirements rows were not updated in this delta even though traceability was. | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1268 design/spec; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1268.md. |
| 3 | MINOR | functional_spec.delta is otherwise byte-identical to the previously approved content, so no FR-level contract absorbed the prune/GC/RLS controls added in design_pack (prior finding only partially resolved via traceability rows). | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1268 design/spec; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1268.md. |
| 4 | MINOR | functional_spec.traceability now has duplicate FR-1 and FR-2 rows with inconsistent `test` field formatting ("file; file" vs single file), mirroring the ambiguous evidence mapping already flagged in test_matrix. | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1268 design/spec; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1268.md. |
| 5 | MINOR | [VERIFIED-PRIOR] EVENT_MIGRATION_BACKUP_REQUIRED still has no owner, coverage row, or test evidence in review_scope files; unchanged and remains unenforced at this gate. | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1268 design/spec; evidence: engineering/design/BI-PF-1268.md. |
| 6 | NIT | EVENT_INLINE_PAYLOAD_LIMIT `default: "deployment"` is not a concrete value; startup_validation "required" makes behavior deployment-dependent and hard to test deterministically. | PENDING | (no response yet) |
| 7 | NIT | FR-4 edge_case "PostgreSQL down" / error "Projection stale marked" does not state projection write atomicity (temp+rename) or staleness metric, though observability lists "projection age". | PENDING | (no response yet) |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Delta resolves the prior data-loss MAJOR: prune is now explicitly forbidden from deleting pending/claimed rows and the bound is enforced via backpressure/disable, preserving dispatch intent until BI-PF-1269.
  Traceability rows now reference outbox-prune and payload-GC tests, partially closing the delta-rule mismatch, but FR requirements/verification rows remain stale.
  Top residual risks: undefined backpressure mechanism for the outbox bound, and migration-down backup enforcement still lacking any test evidence.
